text: Send USD 2024-03-15 fixed 50000 variable 20 price 50 units method units

Break-even units: 1428.57 units. Break-even revenue: 71428.57 USD. Explanation: Fixed costs are 50000 USD, variable cost per unit is 20 USD, and selling price per unit is 50 USD. The formula for break-even units is Fixed Costs / (Selling Price per Unit - Variable Cost per Unit). So, 50000 / (50 - 20) = 50000 / 30 = 1428.57 units. Break-even revenue is break-even units multiplied by selling price per unit: 1428.57 * 50 = 71428.57 USD. The current sales volume is not needed for this calculation.
